text:
julian: Quick heads-up — I'm on the facilitator rota for next ARB (Wed 11:00 PT) but need someone to cover the first ~10m (walkthrough + roll-call). Any volunteers? Also trying a slightly tighter agenda and 24h pre-reads. Calendar & doc links in the event.

mira: I can cover the first 10m, no problem. Will open and hand off to julian for the deep-dive.

sophia: +1 on pre-reads. Can we add a short 'rollout risks' bullet to design reviews? helps SRE/product callouts.

alex: I can take RFC-342 pre-read and give quick summary. @mira ping me if you want me to live note.

ria: small ask — can we add an "ops impact" checkbox in the agenda template so we don't skip infra concerns?

devex-bot: Reminder: please upload slides and any pre-read artifacts to /shared/arb/pre-reads by Tue 11:00 PT to avoid last-minute blockers.

julian: Thanks — putting the compact agenda here so people can copy/edit. Please mark any required pre-reads in the doc.

```
Compact ARB agenda (30–45m):
1) Roll-call & quick updates (5m) — facilitator opens + mana check
2) RFC review (owner 3m summary + 12–15m discussion) — pre-read required
3) Design deep-dive (owner 5m summary + 15–20m discussion) — call out rollout risks/ops impact
4) Triage & action items (5–10m) — owners + next steps
```

mira: Done — I added RFC-342 under "RFC review" and linked a short gist + checklist in the doc.

sophia: If julian ends up OOO next week I can facilitate the whole meeting. Also propose we switch facilitator rotation to biweekly (2-week stints) to reduce churn.

alex: prefer biweekly too. gives time to prep and keeps continuity.

julian: OK let's trial biweekly rotations starting next cycle. I'll update the rotation sheet and calendar. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Event updated: Architecture Review Board — Wed 11:00 PT (recurrence: biweekly). Organizer: julian.

ria: Notes owner — @alex, can you take notes next meeting?

alex: yep, I'll take notes and push minutes to /shared/arb/minutes.

julian: Great — closing loop. If anyone needs to swap facilitator or has agenda items, add them to the doc by Tue 11am or ping me here. Thanks everyone!
